title: anubhavanivedana — anu-p02
question: Half-open-eyed, steady-minded, gaze placed on the nose-tip — moon and sun too have attained dissolution in the interior of the triple-throb state — light-formed, devoid of all exteriority, and one supreme person: reality attains that state, the thing supreme. What more is there to say here?
